item.title: Cowlitz Indian Tribe now official owner of NorthStar Clinic
item.description: The Cowlitz Indian Tribe announced Friday it’s the official owner of Columbia River Mental Health Services’ NorthStar Clinic, settling negotiations that began last year after the nonprofit faced financial woes.

item.title: Wall Street steadies after its AI-induced sell-off
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. stocks steadied on Friday after an encouraging update on inflation helped calm a Wall Street that’s been wracked by worries about how artificial-intelligence technology may upend the business world.

item.title: ‘Quad God’ Ilia Malinin falls twice, allowing Mikhail Shaidorov to claim men’s figure skating gold
item.description: American figure skating sensation Ilia Malinin fell twice in a disastrous free skate that sent him tumbling all the way off the podium at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Friday night, allowing Mikhail Shaidorov to Kazakhstan to claim a stunning gold medal.

item.title: Feds grant Kalama Columbia River ship turnaround project environmental greenlight
item.description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers granted an environmental approval last month to a project that would dredge a 1,000-foot-wide deep-water ship turn around in the Columbia River near the Port of Kalama and expand Longview’s existing turning basin.

item.title: Activists push Tacoma leaders to take tougher ICE stance
item.description: Activists and city leaders disagree over whether Tacoma has done enough to stand against federal immigration authorities — tensions that came to a head at this week’s city council meeting.

item.title: At Fort Bragg, Trump says Maduro raid showed ‘full military might’ of US and means ‘we are feared’
item.description: FORT BRAGG, N.C. (AP) — President Donald Trump celebrated the special forces members who ousted Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, saying last month's audacious raid means “the entire world saw what the full military might” of the U.S. can do and ensured “we are feared” by potential enemies around the world.

item.title: WA lawmaker’s plan to keep used clothing out of landfills hits dead end
item.description: Washington could have become the second state in the country to adopt a framework intended to reduce textile waste and hold companies accountable for the lifecycle of their products.

item.title: 4A Bi-district Boys Basketball: Skyview wins ugly against Sumner to advance to quarterfinals
item.description: Neither Skyview nor Sumner had their best stuff in the opening round of the Class 4A bi-district boys basketball playoffs Friday, but the Storm found a way to win ugly.
